title: Remote Bespoke Dress · Client Measurement Intake

source.fileName: SERPENTIS REGINA - REMOTE BESPOKE DRESS CLIENT MEASUREMENT SHEET.xlsx

notes: POM numbering follows the workbook; RC-21 is not present.
RC-12 and RC-13 retain question-mark annotations in the source measuring methods.
The croquis area refers to a separate PDF; no PDF was included with this workbook.

measurements.label: FULL BUST CIRCUMFERENCE
measurements.howToMeasure: Measure around the fullest part of your bust, over your intended bra. Keep the tape level across your back.

measurements.label: UNDERBUST CIRCUMFERENCE
measurements.howToMeasure: Measure around your rib cage directly beneath your breasts. Keep the tape level and breathe normally.

measurements.label: NATURAL WAIST CIRCUMFERENCE
measurements.howToMeasure: Measure around the most narrow section of torso. Keep the tape close to your body without tightening or drawing in your stomach.

measurements.label: HIGH HIP CIRCUMFERENCE-10CM BELOW WAIST
measurements.howToMeasure: Measure around your body 10 cm below natural waist. Keep the tape level all the way around.

measurements.label: FULL HIP / SEAT CIRCUMFERENCE
measurements.howToMeasure: With feet together, measure around the fullest part of your hips and buttocks. Keep the tape level.

measurements.label: CENTER FRONT NECK TO WAIST
measurements.howToMeasure: Measure from the hollow at the front base of your neck; down the center front to the marked waistline, following your body contour.

measurements.label: SIDE NECK TO BUST POINT
measurements.howToMeasure: Measure from where the side of your neck meets your shoulder, to the fullest point of your bust, on the same side.

measurements.label: BUST POINT TO BUST POINT
measurements.howToMeasure: Measure directly across the front from one nipple to the other. Do not wrap the tape around your body.

measurements.label: SHOULDER LENGTH
measurements.howToMeasure: Measure from where the side of your neck meets your shoulder, to the bony shoulder tip where your arm begins.

measurements.sourceLabel: SIDE NECK TO WAIST- OVER BUST
measurements.label: SIDE NECK TO WAIST- OVER BUST
measurements.howToMeasure: Measure from where your neck meets your shoulder, over the bust point, down to the natural waist on the same side.

measurements.label: NECK BASE CIRCUMFERENCE
measurements.howToMeasure: Measure around the base of your neck where it meets your shoulders. Keep the tape touching your skin without tightening.

measurements.label: ACROSS FRONT CHEST
measurements.howToMeasure: With arms relaxed, measure across your upper chest between the front creases where your arms meet your top torso. (5cm below CF NECK?)

measurements.label: ACROSS BACK
measurements.howToMeasure: With arms relaxed, measure across your back between the rear creases where your arms meet your torso. Follow your back contour. (5cm below CB NECK?)

measurements.label: BACK SHOULDER WIDTH
measurements.howToMeasure: Measure from one shoulder tip to the other, across your upper back; following its contour.

measurements.label: CENTER BACK NECK TO WAIST
measurements.howToMeasure: Measure from the prominent bone at the back base of your neck down the center of your back to the natural waist.

measurements.sourceLabel: CENTER BACK NECK TO FULL HIP
measurements.label: CENTER BACK NECK TO FULL HIP
measurements.howToMeasure: Measure from the back neck bone; down the center of your back, to the marked full-hip level; following your body contour.

measurements.sourceLabel: VERTICAL DEPTH- SIDE NECK TO UNDER ARM LEVEL
measurements.label: VERTICAL DEPTH- SIDE NECK TO UNDER ARM LEVEL
measurements.howToMeasure: Measure vertically from where the side of your neck meets your shoulder, to the horizontal level directly beneath your armpit.

measurements.label: ARMHOLE CIRCUMFERENCE
measurements.howToMeasure: loop the tape over the shoulder tip and beneath the armpit; following the agreed armhole path.

measurements.sourceLabel: SIDE NECK TO CROTCH - FRONT - OVER BUST
measurements.label: SIDE NECK TO CROTCH - FRONT - OVER BUST
measurements.howToMeasure: Measure starting at side neck; passing bust point, down front; stopping at crotch point.

measurements.label: WAIST TO FULL HIP- SIDE
measurements.howToMeasure: Measure down the side of your body; from the natural waist to the marked full-hip level.

measurements.label: WAIST TO KNEE LEVEL- SIDE
measurements.howToMeasure: Measure down the side, from natural waist to the horizontal level of the center of your kneecap.

measurements.label: WAIST TO FLOOR
measurements.howToMeasure: Stand barefoot with feet together. Have your helper measure vertically from your natural waist at your side to the floor.

measurements.label: THIGH CIRCUMFERENCE - 9CM BELOW CROTCH
measurements.howToMeasure: Mark 9 cm down the inner thigh from the crotch crease. Measure horizontally; around the thigh at this level, with your leg relaxed.

measurements.sourceLabel: DESIRED FRONT HEM LENGTH - SIDE NECK
measurements.label: DESIRED FRONT HEM LENGTH - SIDE NECK
measurements.howToMeasure: Wearing your intended shoes, measure from the side-neck point; over your bust to the agreed front hem position.

measurements.label: DESIRED BACK HEM/TRAIN LENGTH
measurements.howToMeasure: Measure from the back neck bone, to the agreed back hem going down Center back.

measurements.label: SHOE HEEL HEIGHT
measurements.howToMeasure: Measure vertically from the floor, to the top of the heel at the back of the shoe. Include a side-view photo of the shoe.

measurements.label: ARM LENGTH - SHOULDER TO WRIST
measurements.howToMeasure: With your elbow gently bent, measure from the shoulder tip; over the elbow to the wrist bone.

measurements.label: SHOULDER TO ELBOW LENGTH
measurements.howToMeasure: With your elbow gently bent, measure from the shoulder tip down the outside of your arm to the point of your elbow.

measurements.label: UPPER ARM CIRCUMFERENCE
measurements.howToMeasure: Measure around the fullest part of your upper arm, with your arm relaxed. Do not flex.

measurements.label: ELBOW CIRCUMFERENCE
measurements.howToMeasure: Bend your elbow approximately 45°. Measure around the elbow, passing the tape over its point without tightening.

measurements.label: FOREARM CIRCUMFERENCE
measurements.howToMeasure: Measure around the fullest part of your forearm with your arm relaxed.

measurements.label: WRIST CIRCUMFERENCE
measurements.howToMeasure: Measure around your wrist at the wrist bones. Keep the tape touching your skin without tightening.

measurements.label: HAND CIRCUMFERENCE
measurements.howToMeasure: Bring your fingers together and tuck your thumb across your palm. Measure around the widest part of your hand, including the thumb.

measurements.sourceLabel: INNER ARM LENGTH - UNDERARM TO WRIST
measurements.label: INNER ARM LENGTH - UNDERARM TO WRIST
measurements.howToMeasure: With your arm slightly lifted and elbow gently bent, measure from the underarm crease; along your inner arm to the wrist bone.
